title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
why_read: An interesting applied AI agents paper on using play-testing agents to automatically redesign games for better player skill progression.
analysis: PlayCraft uses a vision-based AI agent to repeatedly play a generated game, then uses its reported experience to revise the game's design for better engagement and skill mastery. This is a creative combination of agentic evaluation and generative content design, relevant to procedural content generation and game design research. The approach of having agents self-report decisions and reflections to drive iterative design is a useful technique applicable beyond games, such as for tuning any interactive system via simulated users.
